_README: Australian-standard formula lock for the TIA calculator. The check-formulas hook asserts these constants/expressions still exist in the source (catches silent drift), flags conflicting constants for the same formula, and warns on items whose exact standard value is UNVERIFIED. A hook cannot read a paywalled standards PDF, so 'locked' = a value a human confirmed against the cited standard; 'unverified' = present in code but NOT yet confirmed against the source document — confirm and promote to 'locked'.

checks.citation: Austroads AGTM Part 3 / AGTTM - V/C = hourly volume per lane / design capacity per lane
Austroads LOS by V/C (midblock). CONFIRM breakpoints A<=0.6,B<=0.7,C<=0.8,D<=0.9,E<=1.0 against the relevant Austroads/TMR table for the road category.
AGTTM queue method: queue = avg*Ma + oversized*Mo + roadtrain*Mr, multipliers by max stop time (2/5/10/15 min). LV (Ma) 2.4/6/12/18 and HV (Mo) 8/20/40/60 - CONFIRM against AGTTM multiplier table.

AGTTM road-train multiplier (Mr) = 25.2/63/126/189 per stop time (2/5/10/15 min); 12.6 m per RT per minute. Confirmed (user, 2026-06). All paths aligned to this basis. Guard: the old 15.2/38/76/114 basis must NOT reappear.

Shockwave PCE: pceLv=1.0, pceHv=1.4, pceRt=4.1. NOTE these differ from the capacity model's terrain PCE (flat eHV=2.0, eRt=3.0). CONFIRM both against Austroads AGTM Part 3 heavy-vehicle equivalents and reconcile.
Per-lane capacities vph: freeway 1800, multi_lane 1600, arterial 1500, sub_arterial 1200, local 900, rural 850. CONFIRM against Austroads AGTM Part 3 / TMR Road Planning & Design Manual.
Daily->peak-hour factor DETOUR_80TH_HOUR_FACTOR = 0.08 (8% of daily). CONFIRM design-hour factor against Austroads AGTM Part 3 / local DHV practice.
Saturation discharge speed default 25 km/h (shockwave). CONFIRM against Austroads signalised discharge guidance.
Shockwave jam spacings (m): LV 8, HV 24, RT 69. CONFIRM against Austroads vehicle dimensions / jam density basis.
